[[Nicholas the Traveler]] }} The [[Moon Shell]] is a [[trophy]] found from [[Leviathan (species)|Leviathan]]s in [[the Jade Sea]]. [[Luxon]] folklore says that they both shine like the moon, and absorb its power. They are also used in making mirrors. ==Acquisition== * [[Factions]] ** The Jade Sea *** [[Leviathan Claw]] *** [[Leviathan Eye]] *** [[Leviathan Mouth]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Moon Shell#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)]]==== There are many Leviathans within the southern and western portion of the map. Since the [[Outcast]]s are hostile to other inhabitants, let them kill foes of no interest, except of course for the Leviathans you need to engage in order to obtain their drops. Careful pulling may be needed, as multiple mobs (including two Leviathan bosses) are close to each other. Usually awards 2-3 Moon Shells per run. ==Collectors== {{:Kristo Trilios/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|2nd August 2010 and 28th May 2012|Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)|2 [[Moon Shell]]s}} [[Category:Contains dust]]
